Method of Attack: Malware downloader that infects victims, fingerprints their systems, and sends information to a central command & control (C&C) server
Downloads specific modules based on instructions from the C&C server
Contains basic features to detect virtual machines used for malware analysis
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by use of .IQY files, Word docs with macros, .lnk and .vbs attachments)
Attack Vector: Massive waves of spam emails carrying malicious attachments (malspam)
Indicators of Compromise: Use of .IQY files, PDF documents with embedded IQY files, password-protected ZIP archives, Word documents with embedded macros
Campaigns attributed to TA505 actor (Necurs botnet)
